_readme: The coverage manifest. Every surface of the tree, where it is tested, and what is honestly not swept. `node tools/check-coverage.mjs` validates every claim in here against the tree on every gate run: files must exist, named tests must exist, and each invariant's pinning test must actually mention the thing it pins (the `keyword`). The mutation table doubles as the input to `node tools/mutation.mjs`, which breaks each guard and demands the pinning test fail. The narrative version of this file is docs/coverage.md; if the two ever disagree, the checker is right and the prose has rotted.

surfaces.name: girsa-personal
surfaces.what: the personal layer: append-only logs, tombstones, compaction, six stores
surfaces.note: unit-tested inside the crate, including the durability findings M2/M3

surfaces.name: girsa-corpus
surfaces.what: import, continuity, sections, taxonomy, work, redirects
surfaces.note: the re-import invariants the audit called the highest-consequence logic in the tree

surfaces.name: girsa-search
surfaces.what: the index, citation, facets, the widening ladder, proximity
surfaces.note: scoring and facets were 'read for shape only' by the 23-Aug audit; the per-gap proximity contract is new in this pass

surfaces.name: girsa-link
surfaces.what: the link graph, inbound caches, repair layer
surfaces.note: the repair layer the audit said was 'sampled, not swept' is pinned here, including attribution after a restart

surfaces.name: girsa-note
surfaces.what: notes, marks, saved queries, two people's layers
surfaces.note: merge-across-layers refusal is the hard case and is pinned

surfaces.name: girsa-scan
surfaces.what: OCR, paging schemes, anchors, the daf a page is
surfaces.note: paging and anchor arithmetic were 'read for shape only'; the bounded probe is new in this pass

surfaces.name: girsa-lane
surfaces.what: the semantic lane: vectors, signatures, coverage
surfaces.note: the vectors themselves, which the audit said nothing was checked about

surfaces.name: girsa-app
surfaces.what: the library the shell calls: sending, held, workspace, luach, view, arrangement, session
surfaces.note: 22 integration files, including the gates that read the whole tree

surfaces.name: girsa-export
surfaces.what: fixed seforim out to text and word files
surfaces.note: the word-file round-trip is the interop half

surfaces.name: girsa-nearby
surfaces.what: adjacency and what you have not seen
surfaces.note: thin — one integration file and the unseen unit tests

surfaces.name: girsa-desk
surfaces.what: the desk: sessions, refreshing, citing, documents
surfaces.note: unit-tested inside the crate; no integration file

surfaces.name: girsa-mcp
surfaces.what: the MCP server and its tool surface
surfaces.note: the tool surface the audit said was 'sampled, not swept'; the read-only door is pinned

surfaces.name: girsa-fixture
surfaces.note: what every other crate's tests stand on

surfaces.name: app/src-tauri
surfaces.what: the Tauri shell: commands, refusal codes, post, clipboard
surfaces.note: no test files; held by shell clippy, shell fmt, the window suite's wire tests, and the 22 girsa-app gates that read lib.rs

surfaces.name: app/src (the window)
surfaces.note: 24 window test files, ~538 tests, run by `node test/run.mjs`

invariants.name: Near is a per-gap contract
invariants.why: M4: tantivy's slop is a summed budget, so the per-gap promise was recall loss. A mutation that tightens every step by one must be caught.

invariants.name: OCR structural rows are not words
invariants.why: tesseract's TSV carries level-1 and level-4 rows beside the words; if they leaked in, every page's words would be polluted.

invariants.name: Repairs attribute by time, not by key order
invariants.why: minor 17: a replay rebuilds the index through a key-sorted map; without the when-sort your repair attributes to whichever kind sorted last.

invariants.name: An anchor counts for the page it is on, and never a page before it
invariants.why: the boundary is what makes an anchor page its own page; a mutation to `<` unpages the anchor's own page and breaks the bijection between the pages a scan covers and the dafim they carry.

invariants.name: A small layer is never rewritten
invariants.why: M2: the floor is what keeps a store from rewriting the whole file for a stray deletion — and what keeps an unreadable file (0 lines, 0 live) from ever being rewritten at all.

invariants.name: A read-only MCP server refuses writes at the door
invariants.why: a client that remembered the tools from a writable session must be refused by name, not silently written into somebody's layer.

uncovered.what: the downloader's path handling and library layout
uncovered.status: sampled — the path-finding fixes (finding 12) are pinned; the network half of fetch cannot be exercised without the libraries

uncovered.what: the score arithmetic that orders answers
uncovered.status: sampled — order is pinned by offered_not_applied.rs and the typo-queue ranking; the score formula itself is asserted only through those orders
sampled — vectors.rs pins persistence, signatures and restarts; the distance formula is asserted through ranked outcomes only

uncovered.what: adjacency beyond one integration file and unseen.rs
uncovered.status: thin — the smallest crate in the tree and the least swept
unit-tested inside the crate; no integration file exercises it against a real shelf
no shell test files; held by clippy, fmt, the wire tests and the girsa-app gates — not by tests that drive the commands

platform_gated.what: the one thing in the gate that has ever seen a pixel
platform_gated.status: skipped on a machine with no browser — and the gate runs it with EYES_REQUIRED=1 so a skipped eyes is a red step, never a green one
platform_gated.requires: a browser (Edge on Windows, or EYES_BROWSER)

platform_gated.what: the engine probes, bounded but real
platform_gated.status: the engine's absence is pinned as a sentence, not a silence; the hung-probe bound is pinned; a real OCR run needs tesseract with heb installed

platform_gated.what: the window on the other two platforms
platform_gated.status: never seen — docs/not-yet.md is the honest account; the CI matrix builds and lints them, it does not look at them
platform_gated.requires: a Linux desktop with WebKitGTK, a Mac

platform_gated.surface: the semantic lane on a real shelf
platform_gated.status: the lane's coverage disclosure is pinned; an end-to-end embed needs the model and the two-library shelf
platform_gated.requires: the model weights and the shelf

platform_gated.what: the pen's side of the seam
platform_gated.status: CI checks out Ksav beside this tree and catches drift; a live pen is a machine this desk does not have
platform_gated.requires: Ksav's repository and a real pen
